import pulp

# -------------------------
# Data
# -------------------------
T = 14
initial_storage = 29
capacity = 42

demand = {
    1: 32, 2: 22, 3: 25, 4: 19, 5: 24, 6: 29,
    7: 60, 8: 19, 9: 21, 10: 45, 11: 26, 12: 44,
    13: 11, 14: 21
}

pump_min = 13
pump_max = 79
pump_max_day10 = 34
storage_min_day12 = 15

cost_pump = 2
cost_storage = 3
cost_shortage = 8

# -------------------------
# Model
# -------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Desalination_Plan", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
pump = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("pump", (t for t in range(1, T + 1)), lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")
storage = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("storage", (t for t in range(0, T + 1)), lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")
shortage = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("shortage", (t for t in range(1, T + 1)), lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# -------------------------
# Requirements as constraints
# -------------------------

# R1: Initial storage
model += storage[0] == initial_storage, "R1_initial_storage"

# R2: Water balance for each day
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    if t == 1:
        # No pump contribution on day 1 (pump[1] becomes available on day 2)
        model += (
            storage[t]
            == storage[t - 1] - (demand[t] - shortage[t]),
            f"R2_balance_day{t}"
        )
    else:
        model += (
            storage[t]
            == storage[t - 1] + pump[t - 1] - (demand[t] - shortage[t]),
            f"R2_balance_day{t}"
        )

# R3: Pumping limits (general)
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    model += pump[t] >= pump_min, f"R3_pump_min_day{t}"
    model += pump[t] <= pump_max, f"R3_pump_max_day{t}"

# R3 additional upper bound on day 10
model += pump[10] <= pump_max_day10, "R3_pump_max_day10_special"

# R4: Shortage limits
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    model += shortage[t] <= demand[t], f"R4_shortage_ub_day{t}"
    # lower bound already 0 via variable definition

# R5: Storage capacity limits
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    model += storage[t] <= capacity, f"R5_storage_ub_day{t}"
    # lower bound already 0 via variable definition

# R6: Minimum storage on day 12
model += storage[12] >= storage_min_day12, "R6_min_storage_day12"

# R8: Non‑negativity already enforced by lowBound=0 in variable definitions

# -------------------------
# Objective
# -------------------------
total_cost = (
    pulp.lpSum(cost_pump * pump[t] for t in range(1, T + 1))
    + pulp.lpSum(cost_storage * storage[t] for t in range(1, T + 1))
    + pulp.lpSum(cost_shortage * shortage[t] for t in range(1, T + 1))
)
model += total_cost, "Total_Cost"

# -------------------------
# Solve
# -------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# -------------------------
# Output results
# -------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total Cost: {pulp.value(model.objective):.2f}\n")

print("Day | Pumped | Storage End | Shortage")
print("-" * 38)
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    pumped = pulp.value(pump[t])
    stor = pulp.value(storage[t])
    short = pulp.value(shortage[t])
    print(f"{t:3d} | {pumped:6.2f} | {stor:11.2f} | {short:8.2f}")

# Data
# -----------------------------
initial_stock = 65
consumption = {1: 34, 2: 58, 3: 36, 4: 12, 5: 26}
order_min = 15
order_max = 45
lead_time = 2
tank_capacity = 65
procurement_cost = 4
storage_cost = 2
shortage_penalty = 15
planning_horizon = 5

# -----------------------------
# Model
# -----------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Coastal_Treatment_Chemical_Procurement", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
order = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("order", (t for t in range(1, planning_horizon + 1)),
                              lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")
stock = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("stock", (t for t in range(0, planning_horizon + 1)),
                              lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")
shortage = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("shortage", (t for t in range(1, planning_horizon + 1)),
                                 lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")
received = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("received", (t for t in range(1, planning_horizon + 1)),
                                 lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Initial stock
model += stock[0] == initial_stock, "R0_initial_stock"

# -----------------------------
# Requirements as constraints
# -----------------------------

# R1: order[t] >= order_min
for t in range(1, planning_horizon + 1):
    model += order[t] >= order_min, f"R1_min_{t}"

# R2: order[t] <= order_max
for t in range(1, planning_horizon + 1):
    model += order[t] <= order_max, f"R2_max_{t}"

# R3: stock[t] >= 0  (already enforced by lowBound, but named as required)
for t in range(0, planning_horizon + 1):
    model += stock[t] >= 0, f"R3_nonneg_{t}"

# R4: stock[t] <= tank_capacity
for t in range(0, planning_horizon + 1):
    model += stock[t] <= tank_capacity, f"R4_capacity_{t}"

# R5: shortage[t] >= 0  (already enforced by lowBound, but named)
for t in range(1, planning_horizon + 1):
    model += shortage[t] >= 0, f"R5_nonneg_{t}"

# R7: Received[t] = order[t-lead_time] if t-lead_time >= 1, else 0
for t in range(1, planning_horizon + 1):
    if t - lead_time >= 1:
        model += received[t] == order[t - lead_time], f"R7_received_{t}"
    else:
        model += received[t] == 0, f"R7_received_{t}"

# R6: Inventory balance
for t in range(1, planning_horizon + 1):
    model += (stock[t] ==

nodes = ["P", "Q", "R", "S", "T"]
M = 5  # big-M for MTZ

# distances (symmetric)
dist = {
    ("P", "R"): 108.8, ("R", "P"): 108.8,
    ("P", "S"): 167.9, ("S", "P"): 167.9,
    ("P", "T"): 27.6,  ("T", "P"): 27.6,
    ("Q", "R"): 66.8,  ("R", "Q"): 66.8,
    ("Q", "S"): 82.0,  ("S", "Q"): 82.0,
    ("Q", "T"): 105.2, ("T", "Q"): 105.2,
    ("R", "S"): 109.3, ("S", "R"): 109.3,
    ("R", "T"): 135.7, ("T", "R"): 135.7,
    ("S", "T"): 185.4, ("T", "S"): 185.4,
    # the forbidden arcs will be added with distance 0 (they will be forced to 0)
    ("P", "Q"): 0.0, ("Q", "P"): 0.0,
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("InspectionCircuit", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: x[i,j] = 1 if we travel directly from i to j
x = {}
for i in nodes:
    for j in nodes:
        if i == j:
            continue
        # create variable for every ordered pair (including the forbidden ones)
        var = pulp.LpVariable(f"x_{i}_{j}", cat="Binary")
        x[(i, j)] = var

# Auxiliary MTZ variables u[i] (continuous)
u = {}
for i in nodes:
    # bounds 1..M ; later we will fix u[P] = 1
    u[i] = pulp.LpVariable(f"u_{i}", lowBound=1, upBound=M, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize total travelled distance
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(dist[(i, j)] * x[(i, j)] for (i, j) in x), "R0_total_distance"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements translated into constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: each node has exactly one outgoing edge
for i in nodes:
    model += pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for j in nodes if j != i) == 1, f"R1_out_{i}"

# R2: each node has exactly one incoming edge
for j in nodes:
    model += pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for i in nodes if i != j) == 1, f"R2_in_{j}"

# R3: MTZ subtour elimination (for all i != j, i,j != P)
for i in nodes:
    for j in nodes:
        if i == j or i == "P" or j == "P":
            continue
        model += u[i] - u[j] + M * x[(i, j)] <= M - 1, f"R3_MTZ_{i}_{j}"

# Fix the position of the start node P
model += u["P"] == 1, "R3_start_position"

# R4: No travel directly between P and Q
model += x[("P", "Q")] == 0, "R4_no_PQ_forward"
model += x[("Q", "P")] == 0, "R4_no_PQ_backward"

# R5: Exactly one of the two critical corridors must be used
model += x[("Q", "R")] + x[("R", "S")] == 1, "R5_one_critical_corridor"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
status = pulp.LpStatus[model.status]
print(f"Status: {status}")

if status == "Optimal":

}

for pkg in mass.keys():
    var_name = f"x{pkg}"
    x[pkg] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

    pulp.lpSum(mass[pkg] * x[pkg] for pkg in mass) + cooling_penalty * x["C"]
    <= max_takeoff_mass
), "R2_mass_capacity"

    model += x[pkg] >= 0, f"R3_{pkg}_lb"

}

    ("Zeta",   "Theta",103.9),

    ("Eta",    "Theta",122.3)
]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build directed arcs (both directions for each undirected edge)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
arcs = []                     # list of (i, j, distance)
dist = {}                     # distance lookup for a directed arc
for i, j, d in edges_data:
    arcs.append((i, j, d))
    arcs.append((j, i, d))
    dist[(i, j)] = d
    dist[(j, i)] = d

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Technician_Tour", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: binary arc selection
x = {}
for i, j, _ in arcs:
    var_name = f"x_{i}_{j}"
    x[(i, j)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat=pulp.LpBinary)

# MTZ ordering variables (continuous)
u = {}
for n in nodes:
    var_name = f"u_{n}"
    # start node (Alpha) will be fixed later to 1
    u[n] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=1, upBound=N, cat=pulp.LpContinuous)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[model.status])
if pulp.LpStatus[model.status] == "Optimal":
    total = pulp.value(model.objective)
    print(f"Total distance: {total:.2f} km")

        if var.varValue > 0.5:
            print(f"  {i} -> {j}  ({dist[(i,j)]:.1f} km)")
else:
    print("No feasible solution found.")
